Name: Reusable Wallpapers and Floors
Author: iceburg
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/356-0-1462035450.png[/img]
 
Allows you to reuse wallpapers and floors. When you replace a wallpaper or floor, you get the old one back (instead of it being destroyed).
 
 
[b][size=3]Install Instructions
[/size][/b]
1) Install SMAPI
Main page: [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI]https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI[/url]
Install .net, which you need: [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/download/details.aspx?id=30653]https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/download/details.aspx?id=30653[/url]
Install SMAPI: [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases/tag/0.40.0]https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases/tag/0.40.0[/url]
Download the SMAPI Zip, and move the contents toyour Stardew Program Folder (something like: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam
Library\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
 
2) Install the mod:
Extract the zip to your mods folder:
C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Mods
So it should look like:
C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Mods\Reusable Wallpaper


*There seems to be a bug where the first time you replace your kitchen tiles with another flooring you don't get the tiles.
